mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 72 degrees with clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School. The First Quarter moon is out, and early tomorrow at 4:10 AM, you can spot the space station as it travels from over Mount Horeb toward the Fitchburg and Madison area, passing almost directly overhead. We will see an overnight low of 61 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an Engineering Technician to oversee public construction projects through September 20. Additionally, residents should be aware that the city has adjusted sewer and stormwater utility rates to ensure these services remain self-supporting.

We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run today, plus the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market coming up this Tuesday at Hometown Junction Park.
In a report from Friday, August 15, officers arrested a 44-year-old woman for her first O W I offence after she was discovered unresponsive behind the wheel of a vehicle that had come to a stop.

Treat yourself to today's flavor, Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie, which is available until the store closes at 10:30 PM. Also, Kona Ice will be at the Verona Area High School football game starting at 6 PM tonight.
